title: Sync the calendar
only_mine_hint: Events you take part in or that have no participant, tasks assigned to you or to nobody.

export.intro: An .ics file to open in Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar. It is a copy: what changes in Nido afterwards does not reach it.
export.failed: The file could not be prepared. Try again.

subscribe.intro: A secret address to give your calendar app: this calendar shows there and keeps itself up to date. One address per device, so you can revoke just one.
subscribe.label: Device name
subscribe.created_warning: This address will not be shown again. Anyone who has it sees this calendar: do not share it.
subscribe.copy_failed: Copying failed: select the address and copy it by hand.
subscribe.help_google: Google Calendar: on a computer, "Other calendars" → "+" → "From URL". Google reads the address at its own pace, every 8 to 24 hours or so.
subscribe.help_apple: Apple: tap "Open in my calendar" on the iPhone or Mac.
subscribe.never_read: Not read by a calendar app yet
subscribe.revoke_confirm: Revoke "{{label}}"? The calendar app using it will receive nothing more.

import.intro: An .ics file exported from Google, Outlook or Apple: its events become events of this space. A file already imported is not imported twice.
import.notes_capped: Only the first {{count}} notes are shown.

note.UNFOLDED: "{{title}}" repeats in a way Nido cannot say: {{detail}} separate events.
note.UNFOLDED_PARTIAL: "{{title}}" repeats in a way Nido cannot say: {{detail}} separate events, from a year ago to two years ahead.
note.UNFOLDED_PARTIAL_zero: "{{title}}" repeats in a way Nido cannot say: none of its occurrences falls between a year ago and two years ahead.
note.CONVERTED_ZONE: "{{title}}": times converted from the {{detail}} time zone.
note.UNKNOWN_ZONE: "{{title}}": unknown time zone {{detail}}, times taken as they are.
note.CONVERTED_ZONE_unnamed: "{{title}}": times converted from another time zone.
note.UNKNOWN_ZONE_unnamed: "{{title}}": unknown time zone, times taken as they are.

ignored_reason.DUPLICATE_UID: another event in the file has the same identifier
ignored_reason.TOO_HEAVY: its repetition rule takes too much work
ignored_reason.BAD_RULE: its repetition rule cannot be read

feeds.intro: A calendar published at an address (school holidays, a club, a work calendar): Nido reads it again every six hours and shows it in this space, read-only.
feeds.name: Name (optional)
feeds.remove_confirm: Stop following "{{name}}"? Its events leave this space.

errors.network: Nido is not answering. Check your connection.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
errors.forbidden: You may not do that in this space.
errors.not_ics: This file is not an .ics calendar.
errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than 5 MB.
errors.import_too_large: This file holds too many events for one import.
errors.too_many_links: You already have 10 addresses for this space. Revoke one first.
errors.public_url_missing: Nido's public address is not set: an administrator must set it in the settings.
errors.invalid_feed_address: Give an address starting with https://, http:// or webcal://.
errors.refresh_too_soon: This calendar was just read. Try again in a minute.
errors.feed_unavailable: The calendar could not be read: {{reason}}.
